root.label: Subacute Bilateral Eyelid Inflammation with Ectropion and Conjunctival Hyperemia in a Patient with Crohn Disease
supporting_facts: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
excluded_candidates: Infectious conjunctivitis: less likely due to the presence of Crohn disease and the specific findings of blepharitis and ectropion
Allergic conjunctivitis: less likely due to the lack of reported allergies or allergic symptoms
alarm_features: Disease relapse while on infliximab therapy
salient_findings: Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins

static_evidence_items.content: Initial treatment: infliximab therapy (5 mg/kg subcutaneous injection every 8 weeks)
Later treatment: adalimumab (40-mg/0.8-mL subcutaneous injection every 2 weeks) due to disease relapse
Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
Rest of the ophthalmic examination was unremarkable
